findings.frozenDecision: 中远海控 Research selection; not High-priority because record H1 profit and freight rates were already accompanied by a frozen 2022/23 profit-decline path and strong prior rerating.
findings.label: peak_cycle_decline_correctly_blocked
findings.generalLesson: Record current earnings and a low-looking spot multiple are not enough when the contemporaneous market baseline already expects the next two years of profit to decline. V1.2 correctly treated the full path as more important than the headline H1 growth rate.

findings.frozenDecision: 中国神华 Research selection; not High-priority because the coal basket had undergone an extreme 20/60d rerating and outer-year incremental path advantage was unresolved.
findings.label: research_only_after_extreme_rerating_remains_defensible
findings.interpretation: The selection suffered a severe immediate drawdown, then recovered to modest 60d alpha and later produced very large 120d alpha. The later horizon includes a materially changed 2022 energy/geopolitical regime and must not rewrite the pre-registered 60d entry decision.
findings.generalLesson: A durable low-valuation company can remain worth tracking after an extreme rerating, but Research status is useful when entry timing is poor. Later new information should trigger fresh re-underwriting rather than retroactively promote the old decision.

findings.frozenDecision: Auto-chip shortage hypothesis / No selection because company-specific shortage-to-profit attribution was not sufficiently auditable and leading candidates were late_reversal.
findings.label: theme_mapping_and_absorption_correctly_fail_closed
findings.generalLesson: A real physical bottleneck does not justify choosing a semiconductor stock unless economic exposure and incremental earnings are directly attributable.

findings.frozenDecision: DRAM downcycle / No selection because forward physical pricing turned negative and no differentiated long beneficiary was verified.
findings.label: forward_physical_downturn_overrides_stale_trailing_strength
findings.generalLesson: Strong trailing semiconductor earnings should not override an explicit forward industry price deterioration unless a company-specific offset is verified.

durableCashYieldQuestion.interpretation: This strengthens the case that Shenhua has durable economic quality, but it is still the same company and not a clean cross-company repetition of the cash/yield false-negative class. It does not justify a generic v1.3 override.

decision.reason: V1.2 again correctly blocked a peak-profit shipping trap and preserved Shenhua as Research through an extremely absorbed coal regime. The durable-cash/yield omission has still not repeated independently across companies/industries.
decision.nextAction: Run unchanged V1.2 on another untouched historical window, preferably with a different economic mix. Continue looking for independent recurrence before versioning any durability/cash-distribution extension.
